Below is a working unattend answer file that can be used to configure
WinRM on the image. The 32-bit command interpreter path is spelled out
because the surrounding setup step runs 32-bit.

```xml
<SynchronousCommand wcm:action="add">
  <CommandLine>cmd.exe /c winrm quickconfig -q</CommandLine>
  <Order>1</Order>
</SynchronousCommand>
<SynchronousCommand wcm:action="add">
  <CommandLine>C:\Windows\SysWOW64\cmd.exe /c powershell -Command "Set-ExecutionPolicy -ExecutionPolicy RemoteSigned -Force"</CommandLine>
  <Order>2</Order>
</SynchronousCommand>
```
